title: Age of AI: behind Tarluvada’s blue wall in Visakhapatnam
summary: As construction for hyperscale Google AI data centres go full throttle in Visakhapatnam, farmers say promised land and jobs have not arrived
llm_summary: Google is rapidly building massive AI data‑centres on Visakhapatnam’s Tarluvada “blue wall,” but local farmers claim the promised land acquisitions and job opportunities have yet to materialise. While the projects signal India’s push into hyperscale AI infrastructure, the community’s disappointment highlights a growing gap between tech‑driven development and on‑the‑ground socioeconomic benefits.
